title: oauth_authlib_routes not working anymore
body:

### Summary

Hello,

Since the removal of `oauth_authlib_routes` in Streamlit 1.57.0, it looks like `AuthCallbackHandler` is no longer usable.

I was previously relying on it for handling OAuth callbacks, but with the recent changes (Starlette migration), I can’t find any way to restore this functionality.

Is there a recommended alternative to achieve the same behavior in newer versions of Streamlit?  
Or is there any supported way to plug into the OAuth callback flow now?

Thanks in advance for your help!


### Reproducible Code Example

```Python
from streamlit.web.server.oauth_authlib_routes import AuthCallbackHandler
AuthCallbackHandler.get
```

[USER] Thanks for reporting this issue. It's expected that the old `AuthCallbackHandler` won't be available anymore after the migration.

> I was previously relying on it for handling OAuth callbacks, but with the recent changes (Starlette migration), I can’t find any way to restore this functionality.

Do you have more context on what you have been doing with the old `AuthCallbackHandler`? Maybe we can somehow enable the same use case with the new Starlette implementation.
Closing this since we won't bring back the old `AuthCallbackHandler`. Please create a feature request if you are missing some functionality with the new Starlette implementation.
